title: write_content_files does synchronous I/O in async handler
description: posting.rs:28-62. The write_content_files function performs std::fs::create_dir_all and std::fs::write inside an async handler context (called from create_status which is an async axum handler). Blocking I/O in async context blocks the tokio runtime thread. For small files (>4KB threshold) this is unlikely to cause visible latency, but on a slow or network-mounted filesystem it could block the entire worker thread. Compare with media.rs which correctly uses tokio::fs::create_dir_all and tokio::fs::write.
